name: ModelVariant628_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant628_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (a sprite ball arcs away from a model joint while a ring of sparks bursts out of it, and where it lands two wobbling Gouraud domes rise and shed spinning ring bursts); for a non-negative request it packs three texture words, reads the 0xA-byte command row indexed by the request for the start delay, dome radius, height and colour, seeds the balls, domes and bursts and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 4 while a dome is active before the first one ends, 1 once when it ends and 2 when every element is inactive; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the PAL header-645 and 712 images build it from the same source without the work-size printf and its string and bind its data names 0x28 lower; the slot-1 images keep a wrapper only for the format-string padding byte. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
